concerns.text: The specification defines a data contract (`contracts/processed_dataset.schema.yaml`) that must be validated against the generated dataset. No task explicitly references or enforces this contract (e.g., a contract‑validation step), so FR‑014 (log scaffold overlap) and the overall contract compliance are not guaranteed.

FR‑016 requires documentation of the curated fluorophore‑motif reference set’s provenance and selection criteria. Task T012 only describes validation against the reference set but does not create or record the provenance documentation, leaving the requirement unaddressed.
